main_switch2.description: Studio V2 build 33. Build 32 without the full-power start: the heater ramps up like build 31 again, which should stop the three white flashes at the start of a heat-up. Everything else from build 32 stays: on a cold insert the device holds your first temperature itself on presets and custom curves, and a flat preset keeps holding after the buzz. Tested in emulation; your first dab is its first real run.

main_switch2_build31.description: Studio V2 build 31. Everything from build 30, plus: when you start from a cold insert (160 °F or less), the device holds your first temperature with its own heater law until the buzz, so the buzz lands closer to your first point. The heat-up itself ramps up exactly as before. A slow heat-up can now buzz as late as 59 s instead of 52 s rather than stopping short. Warm starts and presets run exactly as build 30. Tested in emulation; your first dabs on it are its first real runs.

main_switch2_build30.description: Studio V2 build 30. Everything from build 29, plus: while the insert is well above a falling line, the heater switches fully off instead of half on, so steep drops run closer to your line. Tested in emulation; your first dabs on it are its first real runs.

main_switchgo.description: Studio V2 Go build 2. Everything from Go build 1 (heat target rounded to the nearest whole degree, top heat capped at 650 F, half the extra heating push let go at ready), plus: the Go won't start a heat under 6 % battery, and it tells this app which Studio features it runs, so the app plans every curve on the right heat law. Your Go keeps reporting SWG-260929 after the install.

main_switchgo_build1.description: Studio V2 Go build 1. The heat target rounds to the nearest whole degree instead of down, the top heat is capped at 650 F, and when the device says ready the heater lets go of half the extra push it built up while heating. Your Go keeps reporting SWG-260929 after the install; this app remembers that it installed Studio.

main_switch2_build29.description: Studio V2 build 29. With Fast Descent on, the device now follows your line only on steep drops, and one misread sensor reading cannot set it off. Holds get stronger heat, so the insert stays on your curve. Everything from builds 27 and 28 stays: Vapor Profiles on the device, the heat target rounded to the nearest whole degree, and power-off from the button.

main_switch2_build32.description: Studio V2 build 32. Everything from build 31, plus: on a cold insert (160 °F or less) the device now holds your first temperature itself on presets AND custom curves, with no setting to turn on, so the heat-up no longer stalls 15-20 °F short and creeps in. The heater goes to full power from the first second instead of a 3.6 s ramp. Warm starts run as build 31. A flat preset keeps holding on its temperature after the buzz. Tested in emulation; your first dabs on it are its first real runs. If a heat-up stops in its first second, install build 31 from this list.
